metadata.title: Fetch & Parse Test Cases
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Fetch test cases from an ADO test suite and parse the XML step format into structured data for execution.

output.description: Parsed test cases with step details: action, expected result, type

prerequisites: Test suite ID and plan ID available
specificActions: Fetch test cases via MCP: testplan_list_test_cases
Parse XML step format into structured data
bestPractices: The list response already includes step XML — no separate wit_get_work_item call needed
Parse both ActionStep and ValidateStep types
First parameterizedString = action, second = expected result

substeps.name: Fetch test cases from ADO
substeps.description: Call MCP to get test cases

substeps.name: Parse XML steps
substeps.description: Extract step data from XML format
actions: For each test case, extract Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.Steps XML
Extract second parameterizedString (expected result for ValidateStep)

substeps.name: Store parsed test cases
actions: Store parsed test cases in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Fetch from ADO → parse XML steps → store in memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Suite and plan IDs from config
